claims.text: README.md@stage-2 lines 3-9: one paragraph saying what Đơn Hàng is (a small, deliberately simple ordering system used as the curriculum's example), what customers and staff do, and its parts (API, Flutter web app, PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak, Docker Compose); it is in Vietnamese.

README.md@stage-2 'Cần có trên máy' (11-20): Docker Desktop; Flutter SDK 3.47 because scripts/up.sh builds the web app on the host; Bash (Git Bash on Windows); .NET SDK only to run tests; kind/kubectl only for Kubernetes lessons.
README.md@stage-2 'Chạy' step 1 is scripts/up.sh; the first run creates dev-only secrets in .env and secrets/, builds the web app, starts every container and waits for them.
.env and secrets/ are listed in .gitignore at stage-2, so a fresh clone does not contain them.

README.md@stage-2 'Đọc tiếp' (51-59) has five pointers: STAGE.md (state of this tag, English, for lesson writers), CHANGELOG.md (what each version changed), /openapi/v1.json on localhost:8080 (API contract), docs/, deploy/k8s/ and scripts/k8s/.
DonHang.App/README.md at stage-2 is unchanged from stage-1: Flutter's template text ('A new Flutter project.').
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang: git diff stage-1 stage-2 -- DonHang.App/README.md (empty); STAGE.md@stage-2:35-36

claims.text: The stage-2 repository root has more than twenty entries, including DonHang.Api, deploy, keycloak, scripts and www.

Run instructions are easy to get wrong when written from memory; they should be exact commands and be run from a fresh clone (by the reviewer or the author on a clean machine) before merging; a README points to deeper documents instead of repeating them.
The README test commands: dotnet test DonHang.slnx for the API, flutter test inside DonHang.App; the app is served on localhost:8081.
Creating a new Flutter app with Flutter's command writes a starter README.md from the template ('A new Flutter project.'), describing the template rather than the app.

self_check.notes: Quotes README.md@stage-2 3-26 and 51-59. Fresh-clone point illustrated with .env/secrets/ gitignored, without claiming the team ran a check.
